summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Molecular Partners AG furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and unaudited interim financial statements. The filing announces financial results and clinical updates, including Phase 1/2a trial initiation for its Radio-DARPin MP0712, but does not disclose any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The CEO's letter and financial details are standard quarterly reporting. No special-situation catalyst is present.
